card.name: Words for bills and laws
card.fires_on: The last word of a legislative term, or the spot just before a bill number, such as 'Bill', 'Act', 'bills', 'law' or 'General Assembly'. It appears in web text about statutes and lawmaking.

modes.label: Bill or act naming
modes.description: Words like Bill, Act, bill or law that name a piece of legislation.
modes.example: This<< bill>> adds to existing federal and state spill reporting

modes.label: Legislature or session citations
modes.description: Parts of a legislative body or session-law citation, such as Assembly, Session or Chapter.
modes.example: In 1999 the Georgia General<< Assembly>> designated it the Georgia Museum of Natural History

modes.label: Before a bill number
modes.description: A space or period right before a bill number.
modes.example: In 1968 Bill<< >>90 was passed by the Union Nation

card.writes: It promotes words for legislation and laws, including Chinese equivalents, so the next word is likely to be about lawmaking.
card.plain: It fires on words naming bills, acts and legislatures in text about how laws are passed.
